info.text:
America's biggest bank made $15.3 billion in three months.
JPMorgan's Q3 2026 profit rose about 6% from $14.4 billion a year ago.
Its card charge-off rate fell to 2.91% from 3.15%, and card spending grew 9.6%.
EPS of $5.57 missed the $5.90 analysts expected (LSEG), and Jamie Dimon warned about sticky inflation and rising rates.
Sources: JPMorgan Q3 2026 earnings release and SEC filing (Oct 13, 2026), CNBC, Yahoo Finance.
News and education, not financial advice.
